acceptedAnswer.text: Six pack enhancement is a cosmetic procedure that uses high-definition liposuction to highlight natural abdominal muscle contours.

mainEntity.name: Is six pack enhancement the same as liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is a specialised form of liposuction focused on sculpting muscle definition rather than general fat removal.
When performed by a qualified surgeon in a licensed facility, it is considered a safe and established procedure.
Most patients return to daily activities within 1–2 weeks, with final results developing over several months.

mainEntity.name: Will I get a visible six pack if I don't exercise?

acceptedAnswer.text: The procedure reveals existing muscle structure, but maintaining definition requires regular exercise and a stable weight.
Results are long-lasting if body weight and fitness levels are maintained.
Scars are minimal and typically hidden within natural skin creases.

mainEntity.name: Who is not a good candidate for six pack enhancement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patients with obesity, loose abdominal skin, or significant muscle separation are usually not suitable candidates.
